title: Next Gen FAA — Northwoods (draft)
text: Strategic screening map for northern MI, WI, and MN Arrowhead. Scores and action classes are produced in ArcGIS Pro (Python in src/); this page only displays pushed hex outputs. Default emphasis: people-first (SCORE_PEOPLE / Goldilocks).

title: Next Gen FAA — Northwoods (draft)
text:
Weight presets (from config)
Dashboard default emphasis is people-first. Presets: people_first (Goldilocks default), plantation_asset_first, pad_first (GAP 1–3), balanced. Goldilocks ranks actionable hexes only (defer_monitor excluded; peat / wetlands included); GOLDILOCKS_PRIORITY runs 0–3 (3 = top 5% people-first). Recreation deferred. Disturbance polygons toggle when files appear in data/disturbances/.
